items.title: Chancellor rejects calls to raise Capital Gains Tax in Budget
items.summary: Influential Labour figures had been pushing for equalising CGT and income tax, but critics have said this could drive wealthy people out of Britain.

items.title: Man charged after Australian MP struck by vehicle
items.summary: Police have charged a man after an Australian MP was hit by a vehicle, causing her to undergo a leg amputation.

items.title: Burnham vows end to 'rip-off parking charges' under new rules
items.summary: The changes come after concerns that penalties issued by private providers are too harsh and leave motorists unfairly punished.

items.title: Britain's first storm of the season named
items.summary: Britain's first named storm of the season is due to hit this week.

items.title: Criminals detained in hospital set to lose benefits
items.summary: The families of the victims of Nottingham killer Valdo Calocane had been campaigning for the change.

items.title: UK unemployment rate falls to lowest level since July last year
items.summary: The UK's unemployment rate has fallen to 4.7%, in a set of official figures that will support the case for a Bank of England interest rate hike next month.
